examples.chinese: 今天是星期五，明天是週末，你們要不要來我家？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqí wǔ, míngtiān shì zhōumò, nǐmen yào bú yào lái wǒ jiā?
examples.english: Today is Friday and it is the weekend tomorrow. Do you want to come to my place?

examples.chinese: 你週末有空嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhōumò yǒukòng ma?
examples.english: Are you available this weekend?

examples.chinese: 我每個週末去學校打籃球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge zhōumò qù xuéxiào dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: I go to school to play basketball every weekend.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我們一起去看海，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn hǎi, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: How about going to watch the sea this weekend?

examples.chinese: 這個週末我們要去騎腳踏車／自行車。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒmen yào qù qí jiǎotàchē/zìxíngchē.
examples.english: This weekend we are going to ride bikes.

examples.chinese: 你這個週末有空嗎？ 我想跟你見面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhège zhōumò yǒu kòng ma? Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ jiànmiàn.
examples.english: Are you free this weekend? I want to meet with you.

examples.chinese: 週末我有空，要約朋友一起去玩。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ yǒu kòng, yào yuē péngyǒu yìqǐ qù wán.
examples.english: I'm free this weekend; I want to make an appointment with friends to go out and have fun together.

examples.chinese: 我覺得當記者不容易，週末常常不能休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dāng jìzhě bù róngyì, zhōumò chángcháng bù néng xiūxí.
examples.english: I think being a reporter is not easy; often I can't rest on weekends.

examples.chinese: 來台灣以後，每個週末我都有很多活動，覺得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, měi ge zhōumò wǒ dōu yǒu hěn duō huódòng, juéde hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: After coming to Taiwan, I have many activities every weekend and feel very happy.

examples.chinese: 這個週末有一場演唱會，你要不要跟我一起去看？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò yǒu yī chǎng yǎnchànghuì, nǐ yào bu yào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù kàn?
examples.english: This weekend there is a concert, do you want to go watch it with me?

examples.chinese: 週末我帶孩子們去鄉下玩，他們餵小羊吃草，拿饅頭給猴子吃，玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ dài háizimen qù xiāngxià wán, tāmen wèi xiǎoyáng chī cǎo, ná mántou gěi hóuzi chī, wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: On the weekend, I took the children to the countryside to play; they fed the lambs grass and gave steamed buns to the monkeys to eat, and they had a great time.

examples.chinese:
小陳很孝順，每個週末都去安養院陪父親聊天、散步，一點兒都不覺得辛苦。
孝順父母的方法很多，最簡單的就是不讓他們擔心、生氣。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Chén hěn xiàoshùn, měi gè zhōumò dōu qù ānyǎngyuàn péi fùqīn liáotiān, sànbù, yīdiǎnr dōu bù juéde xīnkǔ.
Xiàoshùn fùmǔ de fāngfǎ hěn duō, zuì jiǎndān de jiùshì bù ràng tāmen dānxīn, shēngqì.
examples.english:
Xiao Chen is very filial; every weekend he goes to the nursing home to chat and take walks with his father, and doesn't feel the least bit tired.
There are many ways to be filial to parents; the simplest is to not make them worry or get angry.

examples.chinese: 如果這個週末你沒有什麼打算，要不要跟我去看看臺灣規模最大的書店？
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhège zhōumò nǐ méiyǒu shénme dǎsuàn, yào bù yào gēn wǒ qù kànkan Táiwān guīmó zuì dà de shūdiàn?
examples.english: If you don't have any plans this weekend, do you want to go with me to see Taiwan's largest bookstore?

examples.chinese:
珍珍每天大約看兩個小時的臺灣連續劇，目的是要(訓)練自己的中文聽力。
大雄常利用週末練(習)書法，所以漢字寫得比其他同學都好看。
examples.pinyin:
Zhēnzhēn měitiān dàyuē kàn liǎng ge xiǎoshí de Táiwān liánxùjù, mùdì shì yào xùnliàn zìjǐ de Zhōngwén tīnglì.
Dàxióng cháng lìyòng zhōumò liànxí shūfǎ, suǒyǐ Hànzì xiě de bǐ qítā tóngxué dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english:
Zhenzhen watches about two hours of Taiwanese TV dramas every day; her purpose is to train her Chinese listening comprehension.
Daxiong often uses his weekends to practice calligraphy, so he writes Chinese characters more beautifully than any of his classmates.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我過得很充實，不但完成了期末報告，還跟同學去游泳、衝浪。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ guò de hěn chōngshí, búdàn wánchéng le qīmò bàogào, hái gēn tóngxué qù yóuyǒng, chōnglàng.
examples.english: This weekend I had a very full time—not only did I finish my final report, but I also went swimming and surfing with classmates.

examples.chinese: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.
examples.english: The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help.

examples.chinese: 紀先生的部落格擁有不少讀者，下個週末他要辦一場新書活動，買了新書的讀者都可以請他簽名。
examples.pinyin: Jì xiānsheng de bùluògé yōngyǒu bùshǎo dúzhě, xià gè zhōumò tā yào bàn yī chǎng xīnshū huódòng, mǎi le xīnshū de dúzhě dōu kěyǐ qǐng tā qiānmíng.
examples.english: Mr. Ji's blog has quite a few readers; next weekend he will hold a new book event, and readers who have bought the new book can ask him for an autograph.

examples.chinese: 友美，妳這個週末要做什麼？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ zhè ge zhōumò yào zuò shénme?
examples.english: Youmei, what are you going to do this weekend?

examples.chinese: 這兩天天氣有點兒冷，我們週末去，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiān tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, wǒmen zhōumò qù, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is a bit cold those two days. How about we do it this weekend?

examples.chinese: 我平常坐紅線去學校上課，週末也坐捷運去運動、看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zuò hóng xiàn qù xuéxiào shàngkè, zhōumò yě zuò jiéyùn qù yùndòng, kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: I usually go to school by the red one. On weekends I take it to exercise or see a movie as well.

examples.chinese: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
examples.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
examples.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

examples.chinese: 那我這個週末一定要去看看。
examples.pinyin: Nà wǒ zhè ge zhōumò yídìng yào qù kànkan.
examples.english: Well then, I must see it this weekend.

examples.chinese: 我週末還要工作，打算一下班就去看燈會。我們可以約友美一起去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò hái yào gōngzuò, dǎsuàn yí xiàbān jiù qù kàn dēnghuì. Wǒmen kěyǐ yuē Yǒuměi yìqǐ qù.
examples.english: I have to work on weekends, and plan to go to the Lantern Carnival as soon as I get off from work. We can ask Youmei out for the Lantern Carnival together.

examples.chinese: 這家商店的東西很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā shāngdiàn de dōngxi hěn piányi.
examples.english: Stuff in this store is quite cheap.

examples.chinese: 便利商店的服務有賣票、收電話費和水電費等。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn de fúwù yǒu mài piào, shōu diànhuàfèi hé shuǐdiànfèi děng.
examples.english: The services at the convenience store include selling tickets, collecting telephone bills, and water and electricity bills, etc.

examples.chinese:
小黃要去便利商店領錢， 我請他幫我買杯咖啡。
老闆去歐洲旅遊回來，買了荷蘭傳統的點心送給大家，叫我們去助理那裡領。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Huáng yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng qián, wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kāfēi.
Lǎobǎn qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu huílái, mǎile Hélán chuántǒng de diǎnxin sòng gěi dàjiā, jiào wǒmen qù zhùlǐ nàlǐ lǐng.
examples.english:
Xiao Huang is going to the convenience store to withdraw money; I asked him to buy me a cup of coffee.
The boss came back from a trip to Europe and bought traditional Dutch snacks to give to everyone, and told us to pick them up from the assistant.

examples.chinese: 那三家商店都賣相同牌子的皮包，我們最好先比個價，再決定買哪一家的。
examples.pinyin: Nà sān jiā shāngdiàn dōu mài xiāngtóng páizi de píbāo, wǒmen zuìhǎo xiān bǐ ge jià, zài juédìng mǎi nǎ yì jiā de.
examples.english: Those three stores all sell handbags of the same brand; we'd better compare prices first, then decide which one to buy from.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn gòuwù, chúle néng shěng bùshǎo shíjiān, hái kěyǐ bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
examples.english: I like to go shopping at online stores; besides saving a lot of time, they can also deliver the goods to your home.

examples.chinese:
那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。
林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin:
Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le.
Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english:
Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's.
Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 那家便利商店的地理位置非常好，停車也很方便，難怪生意那麼好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā biànlì shāngdiàn de dìlǐ wèizhì fēicháng hǎo, tíngchē yě hěn fāngbiàn, nánguài shēngyì nàme hǎo.
examples.english: That convenience store's geographical location is excellent, and parking is also very convenient; no wonder business is so good.

examples.chinese: 因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi shuǐzāi de guānxi, xǔduō xuéxiào méi bànfǎ zhèngcháng shàngkè, shènzhì lián biànlì shāngdiàn dōu guān le.
examples.english: Because of the flood, many schools cannot have classes normally; even convenience stores have closed.

examples.chinese: 這棟商業大樓的規模很大，除了有很多商店、餐廳，還有電影院、健身房。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng shāngyè dàlóu de guīmó hěn dà, chúle yǒu hěn duō shāngdiàn, cāntīng, hái yǒu diànyǐngyuàn, jiànshēnfáng.
examples.english: The scale of this commercial building is very large; besides many shops and restaurants, there are also a movie theater and a gym.

examples.chinese: 何小姐走路回家時發覺有人跟在她後面，嚇得她趕快跑進便利商店，不敢回家了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě zǒulù huí jiā shí fājué yǒu rén gēn zài tā hòumiàn, xià de tā gǎnkuài pǎo jìn biànlì shāngdiàn, bù gǎn huí jiā le.
examples.english: When Miss He was walking home, she came to know that someone was following behind her, which scared her so much that she quickly ran into a convenience store and didn't dare go home.

examples.chinese: 那個網路商店經常賣假貨，你可別上當。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wǎnglù shāngdiàn jīngcháng mài jiǎhuò, nǐ kě bié shàngdàng.
examples.english: That online store often sells fake goods; you'd better not be tricked.

examples.chinese: 杜先生是三家網路商店的主管，他希望將來能當大企業的老闆，擁有自己的事業。
examples.pinyin: Dù xiānsheng shì sān jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de zhǔguǎn, tā xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng dà qǐyè de lǎobǎn, yǒngyǒu zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.english: Mr. Du is the manager of three online stores; he hopes that in the future he can become the boss of a big enterprise and have his own career.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 小偷：我又沒偷東西，為什麼抓我？ 警察：你先別動，只要看了商店攝影機錄下來的內容，就知道事實了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎotōu: Wǒ yòu méi tōu dōngxi, wèishénme zhuā wǒ? Jǐngchá: Nǐ xiān bié dòng, zhǐyào kàn le shāngdiàn shèyǐngjī lù xiàlái de nèiróng, jiù zhīdào shìshí le.
examples.english: Thief: I didn't steal anything, why are you arresting me? Police: Don't move first; as long as you look at what the store's camera recorded, you'll know the fact.

examples.chinese: 那家飲料店的飲料很好喝，我們去那裡買。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yǐnliào diàn de yǐnliào hěn hǎohē, wǒmen qù nàlǐ mǎi.
examples.english: That beverage store serves great beverages. Let’s go there and get some.

examples.chinese: 我很喜歡這家店的巧克力蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān zhè jiā diàn de qiǎokèlì dàngāo.
examples.english: I like the chocolate cake from this shop.

examples.chinese: 那家店的冰淇淋很好吃，可是有點兒貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī, kěshì yǒudiǎnr guì.
examples.english: That store has delicious ice cream, but it is a bit expensive.

examples.chinese: 我後天要到這家飯店去看朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hòutiān yào dào zhè jiā fàndiàn qù kàn péngyǒu.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow I am going to this hotel to see a friend.

examples.chinese: 學校附近有很多飲料店。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu hěn duō yǐnliào diàn.
examples.english: There are many beverage shops near the school.

examples.chinese: 好多人來這家店買蛋糕，他們的蛋糕一定很好吃吧？
examples.pinyin: Hǎo duō rén lái zhè jiā diàn mǎi dàngāo, tāmen de dàngāo yīdìng hěn hǎochī ba?
examples.english: Many people come to this shop to buy cakes; their cakes must be very delicious, right?

examples.chinese: 我媽媽的花店在百貨公司和超級市場中間。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma de huādiàn zài bǎihuò gōngsī hé chāojí shìchǎng zhōngjiān.
examples.english: My mother's flower shop is between the department store and the supermarket.

examples.chinese: 我們公司附近有很多餐廳和飲料店。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī fùjìn yǒu hěn duō cāntīng hé yǐnliào diàn.
examples.english: Near our company there are many restaurants and beverage shops.

examples.chinese: 在台灣，很多年輕人喜歡當咖啡店的老闆。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, hěn duō niánqīngrén xǐhuān dāng kāfēi diàn de lǎobǎn.
examples.english: In Taiwan, many young people like to be the boss of a coffee shop.

examples.chinese: 那家有名的麵包店賣很多種麵包，都很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yǒumíng de miànbāo diàn mài hěn duō zhǒng miànbāo, dōu hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: That famous bakery sells many kinds of bread; all are delicious.

examples.chinese: 這家飯店又方便又乾淨，而且不貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn yòu fāngbiàn yòu gānjìng, érqiě bú guì.
examples.english: This hotel is both convenient and clean, and moreover not expensive.

examples.chinese: 我同事說那家店的麵包很好吃，大人、小孩都喜歡，很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì shuō nà jiā diàn de miànbāo hěn hǎochī, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xǐhuān, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: My colleague says that bakery's bread is very delicious; both adults and children like it—it's very popular.

examples.chinese: 店員把這台咖啡機的特色說明得非常清楚，聽了他的說明以後，大家都很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Diànyuán bǎ zhè tái kāfēijī de tèsè shuōmíng de fēicháng qīngchǔ, tīngle tā de shuōmíng yǐhòu, dàjiā dōu hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: The clerk explained the features of this coffee machine very clearly. After hearing his explanation, everyone was very interested.

examples.chinese: 這整條街都是賣體育用品的店，只要來這裡就能買到想要的運動鞋。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhěng tiáo jiē dōu shì mài tǐyù yòngpǐn de diàn, zhǐyào lái zhèlǐ jiù néng mǎi dào xiǎng yào de yùndòng xié.
examples.english: This entire street is full of stores selling sports supplies; as long as you come here, you can buy the athletic shoes you want.

examples.chinese: 小元昨天剛買了一件八千元的大衣，沒想到那家服裝店今天打三折，他太吃虧了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoyuán zuótiān gāng mǎi le yī jiàn bāqiān yuán de dàyī, méi xiǎngdào nà jiā fúzhuāngdiàn jīntiān dǎ sān zhé, tā tài chīkuī le.
examples.english: Xiaoyuan just bought an 8,000-yuan coat yesterday; unexpectedly, that clothing store is having a 70% off sale today—he really suffered a loss.

examples.chinese: 客人：這雙皮鞋我穿起來太緊了， 可以幫我換大一點的嗎？ 店員：沒問題，我幫你拿大一號的。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén: Zhè shuāng píxié wǒ chuān qǐlái tài jǐn le, kěyǐ bāng wǒ huàn dà yīdiǎn de ma? Diànyuán: Méi wèntí, wǒ bāng nǐ ná dà yī hào de.
examples.english: Customer: This pair of leather shoes is too tight for me; can you help me exchange them for a bigger size? Clerk: No problem, I'll get you a size larger.

examples.chinese: 這家專櫃的店員比剛才那家的還要兇，難怪生意這麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhuānguì de diànyuán bǐ gāngcái nà jiā de hái yào xiōng, nánguài shēngyì zhème chà.
examples.english: The clerk at this brand counter is even fiercer than the one at the previous store; no wonder business is so bad.

examples.chinese: 購物時我喜歡一個人慢慢看，不太喜歡店員一直向我推銷。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shí wǒ xǐhuān yí ge rén mànmàn kàn, bú tài xǐhuān diànyuán yìzhí xiàng wǒ tuīxiāo.
examples.english: When shopping, I like to look around slowly by myself; I don't really like salesclerks constantly trying to sell to me.

examples.chinese:
付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。
他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin:
Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán.
Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english:
When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk.
He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 如果這個週末你沒有什麼打算，要不要跟我去看看臺灣規模最大的書店？
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhège zhōumò nǐ méiyǒu shénme dǎsuàn, yào bù yào gēn wǒ qù kànkan Táiwān guīmó zuì dà de shūdiàn?
examples.english: If you don't have any plans this weekend, do you want to go with me to see Taiwan's largest bookstore?

examples.chinese: 那家店正在推銷巧克力口味的小籠包，我們要不要去嘗試一下？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zhèngzài tuīxiāo qiǎokèlì kǒuwèi de xiǎolóngbāo, wǒmen yào bù yào qù chángshì yīxià?
examples.english: That shop is promoting chocolate-flavored soup dumplings; shall we go try them?

examples.chinese: 有一些父母不讓孩子去夜店，主要是因為聽說那裡有人吸毒，也買得到毒品。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē fùmǔ bù ràng háizi qù yèdiàn, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi tīngshuō nàlǐ yǒu rén xīdú, yě mǎi de dào dúpǐn.
examples.english: Some parents don't let their children go to nightclubs, mainly because they've heard that people take drugs there and that drugs can be bought there.

examples.chinese: 刷卡購物時，店員會先確認你的簽名是不是和信用卡上的相同。
examples.pinyin: Shuākǎ gòuwù shí, diànyuán huì xiān quèrèn nǐ de qiānmíng shì bùshì hé xìnyòngkǎ shàng de xiāngtóng.
examples.english: When paying by credit card, the clerk will first confirm whether your signature is the same as the one on the credit card.

examples.chinese: 林小姐從小就希望有一家屬於自己的麵包店，今年終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù xīwàng yǒu yī jiā shǔyú zìjǐ de miànbāodiàn, jīnnián zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn le.
examples.english: Miss Lin has hoped since childhood to have a bakery that belongs to herself; this year her dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese:
這個保養品很適合皮膚乾的人，所以秋冬兩個季節銷售得非常好。
因為店員的服務態度很好，所以這個專櫃的銷售成績是最好的。
examples.pinyin:
Zhège bǎoyǎngpǐn hěn shìhé pífū gān de rén, suǒyǐ qiū dōng liǎng ge jìjié xiāoshòu de fēicháng hǎo.
Yīnwèi diànyuán de fúwù tàidù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhège zhuān guì de xiāoshòu chéngjì shì zuì hǎo de.
examples.english:
This skincare product is very suitable for people with dry skin, so its sales in the autumn and winter seasons are very good.
Because the staff's service attitude is very good, this counter's sales performance is the best.

examples.chinese: 那個店員的工作態度很隨便，常弄錯商品的價格，還找錯錢， 真是太誇張了！
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán de gōngzuò tàidù hěn suíbiàn, cháng nòngcuò shāngpǐn de jiàgé, hái zhǎo cuò qián, zhēn shì tài kuāzhāng le!
examples.english: That clerk's work attitude is very careless; he often gets the product prices wrong and also gives the wrong change—that's really too outrageous!

examples.chinese: 那個店員只顧著玩手機，客人來了都不知道。
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán zhǐ gùzhe wán shǒujī, kèrén lái le dōu bù zhīdào.
examples.english: That clerk only cared about playing on his phone; he didn't even notice when customers came.

examples.chinese:
那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。
這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin:
Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi.
Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english:
The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically.
This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 這本中文教材是網路書店出版的，你得上網才買得到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn zhōngwén jiàocái shì wǎnglù shūdiàn chūbǎn de, nǐ děi shàngwǎng cái mǎi de dào.
examples.english: This Chinese textbook is published by an online bookstore; you have to go online to be able to buy it.

examples.chinese: 我們下午四點要到天美飯店，她在那裡等我們。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sì diǎn yào dào Tiānměi Fàndiàn, tā zài nàli děng wǒmen.
examples.english: We have to arrive at Tianmei Hotel at 4 in the afternoon. She will wait for us there.

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.chinese: 友美，妳看，天美飯店在大學路。我現在知道怎麼走了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ kàn, Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài Dàxué Lù. Wǒ xiànzài zhīdào zěnme zǒu le.
examples.english: Look, Youmei. Tianmei Hotel is on Daxue Road. Now I know how to get there.

examples.chinese: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
examples.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
examples.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

items.wordHook: A corner under the 广(broad) roof is 占(occupied) by a shop sign → the 店(shop).

examples.chinese: 我買了三個麵包，吃了兩個了，最後一個明天再吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le sān gè miànbāo, chī le liǎng gè le, zuìhòu yī gè míngtiān zài chī.
examples.english: I bought three breads, I have eaten two, I will eat the last one tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 這個演唱會，從開始到最後都很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yǎnchànghuì, cóng kāishǐ dào zuìhòu dōu hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: This concert was great from start to finish.

examples.chinese: 那個明星演戲前都會先研究戲裡的人物、故事，最後才決定表演的方式。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng yǎnxì qián dōu huì xiān yánjiū xì lǐ de rénwù, gùshì, zuìhòu cái juédìng biǎoyǎn de fāngshì.
examples.english: Before that star acts in a drama, he always first studies the characters and story in the play, and only then decides on the way to perform.

examples.chinese: 小歐為了省錢，整個月都吃泡麵，最後吃壞了身體，吃藥、住院花了更多錢。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Ōu wèile shěng qián, zhěngge yuè dōu chī pàomiàn, zuìhòu chī huài le shēntǐ, chī yào, zhùyuàn huā le gèng duō qián.
examples.english: In order to save money, Xiao Ou ate instant noodles for a whole month; in the end, he ruined his health, and spent even more money on medicine and hospitalization.

examples.chinese:
小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。
經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò.
Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english:
Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job.
After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友到餐廳點了好多菜，最後沒吃完，只好打包回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou dào cāntīng diǎn le hǎo duō cài, zuìhòu méi chī wán, zhǐhǎo dǎbāo huí jiā.
examples.english: My friend and I went to a restaurant and ordered a lot of dishes. In the end, we couldn't finish them, so we had to pack them to take home.

examples.chinese:
我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。
那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā.
Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english:
I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight.
That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: 參加這次總統選舉的人實力都不錯，最後是陳先生當選了。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā zhè cì zǒngtǒng xuǎnjǔ de rén shílì dōu bùcuò, zuìhòu shì Chén xiānsheng dāngxuǎn le.
examples.english: The people who participated in this presidential election all had good qualifications; in the end, Mr. Chen was elected.

examples.chinese:
我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。
A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le.
A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english:
I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home.
A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: 林伯伯透過網路、報紙，尋找三十年前因為戰爭而分開的家人，最後終於找到了。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo tòuguò wǎnglù, bàozhǐ, xúnzhǎo sānshí nián qián yīnwèi zhànzhēng ér fēnkāi de jiārén, zuìhòu zhōngyú zhǎodào le.
examples.english: Uncle Lin searched through the Internet and newspapers for family members separated thirty years ago because of war, and finally found them.

examples.chinese: 那位客人在地攤買東西揀來揀去，最後又不買，難怪老闆滿臉不高興的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi kèrén zài dìtān mǎi dōngxi jiǎn lái jiǎn qù, zuìhòu yòu bù mǎi, nánguài lǎobǎn mǎn liǎn bù gāoxìng de yàngzi.
examples.english: That customer kept picking and choosing while shopping at the street stall, and in the end didn’t buy anything; no wonder the owner looked unhappy.

examples.chinese: 這場棒球比賽已打到最後一局，可是仍無法看出誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bàngqiú bǐsài yǐ dǎ dào zuìhòu yì jú, kěshì réng wúfǎ kànchū shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: This baseball game has already reached the final inning, but it is still impossible to tell who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 夏天的時候，芒果冰、西瓜汁的生意好得不得了！
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, mángguǒ bīng, xīguā zhī de shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo!
examples.english: In summer, the business of mango shaved ice and watermelon juice is extremely good!

examples.chinese: 那家貿易公司跟美國做生意，職員都得會說英文。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā màoyì gōngsī gēn Měiguó zuò shēngyì, zhíyuán dōu děi huì shuō Yīngwén.
examples.english: That trade company does business with America, so the employees all have to be able to speak English.

examples.chinese: 那家超市的生意非常好，因為他們進了很多特別的零食，大人、小孩都想嘗嘗看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshì de shēngyì fēicháng hǎo, yīnwèi tāmen jìn le hěn duō tèbié de língshí, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xiǎng chángchang kàn.
examples.english: That supermarket's business is very good because they have stocked many special snacks; both adults and children want to taste them.

examples.chinese: 這家專櫃的店員比剛才那家的還要兇，難怪生意這麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhuānguì de diànyuán bǐ gāngcái nà jiā de hái yào xiōng, nánguài shēngyì zhème chà.
examples.english: The clerk at this brand counter is even fiercer than the one at the previous store; no wonder business is so bad.

examples.chinese:
李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。
今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin:
Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo.
Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english:
Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good.
Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 那家便利商店的地理位置非常好，停車也很方便，難怪生意那麼好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā biànlì shāngdiàn de dìlǐ wèizhì fēicháng hǎo, tíngchē yě hěn fāngbiàn, nánguài shēngyì nàme hǎo.
examples.english: That convenience store's geographical location is excellent, and parking is also very convenient; no wonder business is so good.

examples.chinese: 這條馬路高低不平，為了避免發生意外，開車經過時一定要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo mǎlù gāodī bù píng, wèile bìmiǎn fāshēng yìwài, kāichē jīngguò shí yīdìng yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This road is uneven (high and low, not flat); in order to avoid accidents, you must be careful when driving through.

examples.chinese: 那個老闆做生意不老實，一再跟客人保證商品沒問題，其實是騙人的。
examples.pinyin: Nàge lǎobǎn zuò shēngyì bù lǎoshí, yīzài gēn kèrén bǎozhèng shāngpǐn méi wèntí, qíshí shì piànrén de.
examples.english: That boss is not honest in doing business; he repeatedly assures customers that the products have no problems, but actually it's a scam.

examples.chinese: 簡老闆因為生意的關係，經常接觸越南人，相當了解兩國之間工作習慣的差異。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎn lǎobǎn yīnwèi shēngyì de guānxì, jīngcháng jiēchù Yuènánrén, xiāngdāng liǎojiě liǎng guó zhījiān gōngzuò xíguàn de chāyì.
examples.english: Boss Jian, because of business, frequently contacts Vietnamese people and quite understands the differences in working habits between the two countries.

examples.chinese: 他把存了半輩子的錢都拿去做生意，結果生意不成功，錢都沒了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ cún le bànbèizi de qián dōu ná qù zuò shēngyì, jiéguǒ shēngyì bù chénggōng, qián dōu méi le.
examples.english: He took all the money he had saved for half his life to do business, but the business was unsuccessful, and all the money was gone.

examples.chinese: 為了避免兒童發生意外，家長在樓梯邊裝了安全網。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn értóng fāshēng yìwài, jiāzhǎng zài lóutī biān zhuāng le ānquán wǎng.
examples.english: To avoid accidents involving children, the parents installed a safety net beside the stairs.

examples.chinese: 王先生投資生意的眼光很好，讓他僅僅一年就買下了好幾棟大樓。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng tóuzī shēngyì de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, ràng tā jǐnjǐn yī nián jiù mǎi xià le hǎo jǐ dòng dàlóu.
examples.english: Mr. Wang's eye for investing in business is very good; it made him buy several buildings in just one year.

examples.chinese: 他這幾年因為投資生意發了，婚姻生活也很幸福，運氣非常好。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè jǐ nián yīnwèi tóuzī shēngyì fā le, hūnyīn shēnghuó yě hěn xìngfú, yùnqì fēicháng hǎo.
examples.english: In recent years he has become wealthy from investing in business, his married life is also very happy, and his luck is extremely good.

examples.chinese: 冰店的生意好壞得看季節，冬天的生意總是不如夏天。
examples.pinyin: Bīngdiàn de shēngyì hǎohuài děi kàn jìjié, dōngtiān de shēngyì zǒngshì bùrú xiàtiān.
examples.english: Whether a shaved ice shop's business is good or bad depends on the season; business in winter is always not as good as in summer.

examples.chinese: 他曾替公司談成了三億美元的生意，因此老闆讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Tā céng tì gōngsī tán chéng le sān yì měiyuán de shēngyì, yīncǐ lǎobǎn ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: He once negotiated a three-hundred-million-dollar deal for the company, so the boss made him manager.

examples.chinese: 那家禮品店的商品樣式不錯，並且價格合理，所以生意很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā lǐpǐn diàn de shāngpǐn yàngshì bùcuò, bìngqiě jiàgé hélǐ, suǒyǐ shēngyì hěn hǎo.
examples.english: That gift shop's product styles are quite good, and also the prices are reasonable, so business is very good.

examples.chinese: 假如他不聽你的，颱風天堅持去爬山，發生意外也是他活該。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú tā bù tīng nǐ de, táifēng tiān jiānchí qù páshān, fāshēng yìwài yě shì tā huógāi.
examples.english: If he doesn't listen to you and insists on going mountain climbing on a typhoon day, if an accident happens, it serves him right.

examples.chinese: 做生意前得先算一下成本，划算才去做。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shēngyì qián děi xiān suàn yíxià chéngběn, huásuàn cái qù zuò.
examples.english: Before doing business, you must first calculate the costs; only do it if it's worth it.

examples.chinese: 那家早餐店的生意很好，你得早點(兒)去，才買得到早點。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā zǎocāndiàn de shēngyì hěn hǎo, nǐ děi zǎodiǎnr qù, cái mǎi de dào zǎodiǎn.
examples.english: That breakfast shop does good business; you have to go a bit earlier to be able to buy breakfast.

examples.chinese: 談生意時千萬別打斷客戶的話，不然做生意的機會很可能就斷了。
examples.pinyin: Tán shēngyì shí qiānwàn bié dǎduàn kèhù de huà, bùrán zuò shēngyì de jīhuì hěn kěnéng jiù duàn le.
examples.english: When discussing business, never interrupt the client, otherwise the opportunity to do business may very well be broken off.

examples.chinese: 開車去喝喜酒的人碰到敬酒時最好拒絕，免得回家路上發生意外。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē qù hē xǐjiǔ de rén pèngdào jìngjiǔ shí zuìhǎo jùjué, miǎnde huíjiā lùshàng fāshēng yìwài.
examples.english: People who drive to drink wedding wine had best refuse when they encounter a toast, so as to avoid an accident on the way home.

examples.chinese: 接待客戶是有技巧的，弄不好可能會丟了生意。
examples.pinyin: Jiēdài kèhù shì yǒu jìqiǎo de, nòng bù hǎo kěnéng huì diū le shēngyì.
examples.english: Receiving clients requires skill; if you don't handle it well, you might lose the business.

examples.chinese: 出國旅行最好辦個保險，發生意外時才能獲得保障。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó lǚxíng zuìhǎo bàn ge bǎoxiǎn, fāshēng yìwài shí cái néng huòdé bǎozhàng.
examples.english: When traveling abroad, it is best to get insurance; only then can you obtain protection when an accident occurs.

examples.chinese: 孫小姐最近談成了幾筆大生意，表現出色，於是公司決定提高她的薪水。
examples.pinyin: Sūn xiǎojiě zuìjìn tán chéng le jǐ bǐ dà shēngyì, biǎoxiàn chūsè, yúshì gōngsī juédìng tígāo tā de xīnshuǐ.
examples.english: Miss Sun recently closed several big deals and her performance was outstanding, so the company decided to raise her salary.

examples.chinese: 做生意與其花大錢廣告，不如提高品質，讓顧客替你宣傳。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shēngyì yǔqí huā dà qián guǎnggào, bùrú tígāo pǐnzhí, ràng gùkè tì nǐ xuānchuán.
examples.english: In doing business, rather than spending a lot of money to advertise, it is better to improve quality and let customers promote you.

examples.chinese: 我上次口試的時候太緊張，所以沒聽懂老師問的問題。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shàng cì kǒushì de shíhòu tài jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ méi tīngdǒng lǎoshī wèn de wèntí.
examples.english: Last time during the oral test, I was too nervous, so I didn't understand the questions the teacher asked.

examples.chinese: 下星期一有課堂小考和口試，我得好好準備。
examples.pinyin: Xià xīngqīyī yǒu kètáng xiǎokǎo hé kǒushì, wǒ děi hǎohǎo zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: Next Monday there's a class quiz and an oral test; I must prepare well.

examples.chinese: 今天中文口試時我太緊張了，一時不知道怎麼回答，所以成績不太好。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān Zhōngwén kǒushì shí wǒ tài jǐnzhāng le, yīshí bù zhīdào zěnme huídá, suǒyǐ chéngjī bù tài hǎo.
examples.english: During the Chinese oral exam today, I was too nervous and for a moment didn't know how to answer, so my grade wasn't very good.

examples.chinese: 老師說這次口試的題目不難，回答是只要放輕鬆、別緊張，就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō zhè cì kǒushì de tímù bù nán, huídá shì zhǐyào fàng qīngsōng, bié jǐnzhāng, jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: The teacher said the questions on this oral exam are not hard; the answer is that as long as you relax and don't be nervous, there's no problem.

examples.chinese: 陳可欣極重視考試的成績，可是她覺得參加社團也會有很多收穫。
examples.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn jí zhòngshì kǎoshì de chéngjì, kěshì tā juéde cānjiā shètuán yě huì yǒu hěn duō shōuhuò.
examples.english: Chen Kexin highly values exam grades, but she feels that joining clubs will also bring many rewards.

examples.chinese: 參加社團活動，是讓自己成長的好機會。孩子出國留學以後，父母發現孩子成長了不少。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng, shì ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng de hǎo jīhuì. Háizi chūguó liúxué yǐhòu, fùmǔ fāxiàn háizi chéngzhǎng le bùshǎo.
examples.english: Participating in club activities is a good opportunity for personal growth. After their child went abroad to study, the parents found that the child had grown a lot.

examples.chinese: 許多大學生參加愛心服務的社團，幫助老人打掃環境。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō dàxuéshēng cānjiā àixīn fúwù de shètuán, bāngzhù lǎorén dǎsǎo huánjìng.
examples.english: Many university students join volunteer service clubs to help the elderly clean up the environment.

examples.chinese: 他參加了服務社團的活動後，生活比過去更豐富、更有意義。
examples.pinyin: Tā cānjiā le fúwù shètuán de huódòng hòu, shēnghuó bǐ guòqù gèng fēngfù, gèng yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: After he participated in the service club's activities, his life has become richer and more meaningful than in the past.

examples.chinese: 在學習中文的期間，小林下課後除了複習功課，也和同學參加了不少社團活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuéxí Zhōngwén de qījiān, Xiǎo Lín xiàkè hòu chúle fùxí gōngkè, yě hé tóngxué cānjiā le bùshǎo shètuán huódòng.
examples.english: During the period of studying Chinese, after class Xiao Lin not only reviewed his lessons but also participated in quite a few club activities with classmates.

examples.chinese: 從我加入這個健身社團後，不但作息正常了，身體也更健康了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiārù zhège jiànshēn shètuán hòu, bùdàn zuòxī zhèngcháng le, shēntǐ yě gèng jiànkāng le.
examples.english: Ever since I joined this fitness club, not only has my daily routine become regular, but my health has also improved.

examples.chinese: 透過社群網站，我們可以加入感興趣的社團，讓自己的生活更充實。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, wǒmen kěyǐ jiārù gǎn xìngqù de shètuán, ràng zìjǐ de shēnghuó gèng chōngshí.
examples.english: Through social media, we can join clubs we are interested in, making our lives more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 易先生從職場退休後，就加入了醫院的服務社團，繼續為社會貢獻一份力量。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng cóng zhíchǎng tuìxiū hòu, jiù jiārù le yīyuàn de fúwù shètuán, jìxù wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng.
examples.english: After Mr. Yi retired from the workplace, he joined the hospital's service club and continued to contribute his part to society.

examples.chinese: 老師把安養院社團的社員分成兩個小組，第一組陪老人唱歌， 第二組陪老人玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ ānyǎngyuàn shètuán de shèyuán fēnchéng liǎng ge xiǎozǔ, dì-yī zǔ péi lǎorén chànggē, dì-èr zǔ péi lǎorén wán yóuxì.
examples.english: The teacher divided the members of the nursing home club into two groups: the first group sang songs with the elderly, and the second group played games with the elderly.

examples.chinese: 在網路上，商品的交易雖然方便，但也應注意安全問題。許小姐知道社團網友想賣手機，就拿二手(second hand)筆電去交易，結果對方同意了。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù shàng, shāngpǐn de jiāoyì suīrán fāngbiàn, dàn yě yīng zhùyì ānquán wèntí. Xǔ xiǎojiě zhīdào shètuán wǎngyǒu xiǎng mài shǒujī, jiù ná èrshǒu bǐdiàn qù jiāoyì, jiéguǒ duìfāng tóngyì le.
examples.english: Online, although product transactions are convenient, you should also pay attention to safety issues. Miss Xu knew that a club netizen wanted to sell a cell phone, so she took a second-hand laptop to trade, and the other party agreed.

examples.chinese: 家裡用不到的毯子可以拿給環保社團，他們會送給需要的家庭。
examples.pinyin: Jiālǐ yòng bù dào de tǎnzi kěyǐ ná gěi huánbǎo shètuán, tāmen huì sòng gěi xūyào de jiātíng.
examples.english: Blankets that are not used at home can be given to environmental groups; they will give them to families in need.

examples.chinese: 每次當我回憶起大學的社團生活，就會想到那一群知心好友。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dāng wǒ huíyì qǐ dàxué de shètuán shēnghuó, jiù huì xiǎngdào nà yī qún zhīxīn hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: Every time I recall my university club life, I think of that group of close friends.

examples.chinese: 我跟幾個愛好歷史的朋友一起組了社團，專門研究古文物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn jǐ ge àihào lìshǐ de péngyǒu yìqǐ zǔ le shètuán, zhuānmén yánjiū gǔ wénwù.
examples.english: I formed a club together with several friends who love history, specifically to study ancient artifacts.

examples.chinese: 電視新聞說，最近有很多人抱怨手機的電池有問題。
examples.pinyin: Diànshì xīnwén shuō, zuìjìn yǒu hěn duō rén bàoyuàn shǒujī de diànchí yǒu wèntí.
examples.english: TV news says that recently many people have complained that cell phone batteries have problems.

examples.chinese: 我昨天親眼看到小史跟人吵架，才知道他罵人的樣子好可怕喔！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān qīnyǎn kàndào Xiǎo Shǐ gēn rén chǎojià, cái zhīdào tā mà rén de yàngzi hǎo kěpà o!
examples.english: Yesterday I saw with my own eyes Xiao Shi arguing with someone, and only then did I realize how scary he looks when he scolds people!

examples.chinese:
我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。
金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú.
Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english:
My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish.
Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

items.wordHook: Combining 親(relatives) and 眼(glance): 親眼 means with one's own eyes.

items.key: ["B3L10-1-30","说也奇怪","說也奇怪","说也奇怪","Ph"]

examples.chinese: 林伯伯覺得最近身體的毛病不少，可是說也奇怪，醫生檢查後都說他很正常。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo juéde zuìjìn shēntǐ de máobìng bù shǎo, kěshì shuō yě qíguài, yīshēng jiǎnchá hòu dōu shuō tā hěn zhèngcháng.
examples.english: Uncle Lin feels that he has quite a few health problems recently, but strange to say, after the doctor's examination, they all say he is very normal.

examples.chinese: 到底上帝存在不存在，科學與宗教的觀點不同，說法也不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ Shàngdì cúnzài bù cúnzài, kēxué yǔ zōngjiào de guāndiǎn bùtóng, shuōfǎ yě bù yīyàng.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not, the viewpoints of science and religion are different, and their explanations are also different.

examples.chinese: 我雖然尊敬他，卻不認同他所堅持的觀點。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ suīrán zūnjìng tā, què bù rèntóng tā suǒ jiānchí de guāndiǎn.
examples.english: Although I respect him, I do not approve of the viewpoint he insists on.

examples.chinese: 這件事大家都堅持自己的觀點，討論不出結果，還是找個說話有分量的人來決定吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì dàjiā dōu jiānchí zìjǐ de guāndiǎn, tǎolùn bù chū jiéguǒ, háishì zhǎo gè shuōhuà yǒu fènliàng de rén lái juédìng ba.
examples.english: In this matter, everyone insists on their own viewpoint, and no result can be reached through discussion; it would be better to find someone whose words carry weight to decide.

examples.chinese: 你最好別穿著拖鞋去參加正式活動，要不然別人可能認為你不懂禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo bié chuān zhe tuōxié qù cānjiā zhèngshì huódòng, yàobùrán biérén kěnéng rènwéi nǐ bù dǒng lǐmào.
examples.english: You'd better not wear slippers to attend a formal event, otherwise others might think you don't understand manners.

examples.chinese: A:這幾雙拖鞋我都喜歡，不知道怎麼挑選？ B:這容易，你挑雙便宜的就好。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhè jǐ shuāng tuōxié wǒ dōu xǐhuān, bù zhīdào zěnme tiāoxuǎn? B: Zhè róngyì, nǐ tiāo shuāng piányi de jiù hǎo.
examples.english: A: I like all these pairs of slippers; I don't know how to choose? B: That's easy, just pick a cheap pair.

examples.chinese: 明天的露營活動還欠什麼東西？我可以帶過來。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de lùyíng huódòng hái qiàn shénme dōngxi? Wǒ kěyǐ dài guòlái.
examples.english: What else do we still owe for tomorrow's camping activity? I can bring it over.

examples.chinese: 有些事情光是勤勞沒有用，得用對方法才行。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shìqíng guāng shì qínláo méiyǒu yòng, děi yòng duì fāngfǎ cái xíng.
examples.english: For some things, just being hardworking is not useful; you have to use the right method.

items.key: ["B4L12-1-48","可遇不可求","可遇不可求","可遇不可求","Ph"]

items.wordHook: Holding a cherished 夢(dream) and heartfelt 想(believe) wish until it comes 成(become) into 真(real) reality: 夢想成真 means dreams come true.
Repeating 天(sky) twice for emphasis: 天天 means every day, daily.
妹(younger sister), said twice: 妹妹(younger sister).
Navigating the proper 道(way) step by 寸(inch) leads travelers correctly to 導(direct).
a 乍(first) thought in the 心(heart) asks → 怎(how) to start?
The 日(sun) meets the 月(moon) at dusk → 明(bright).
Combining 辦(set up) and 理(reason): 辦理 means deal with, to attend to.
a 馬(horse) takes the 奇(strange) path → one 騎(ride) away.
